name: @x18n/monorepo
description: Manage and view i18n files of any project, for humans and agents
author: Anthony Fu <anthonyfu117@hotmail.com>

scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test --run && x18n check --strict && pnpm -C docs run generate --check
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && simple-git-hooks && skills experimental_sync -y --exclude @x18n/cli
scripts.test:real-world: pnpm run build && X18N_REAL_WORLD=1 vitest run --project real-world

scripts-info.dev: Start the UI in dev mode
scripts-info.codegen: Generate files that typecheck needs (Nuxt types, VS Code extension meta)
scripts-info.docs: Start the docs site in dev mode
scripts-info.start: Run the CLI entry (pass arguments after `--`)
scripts-info.knip: Find unused files, exports and dependencies
scripts-info.test: Build, then run the test suite
scripts-info.ci: Run the full continuous integration pipeline
scripts-info.prepare: Set up git hooks and skills
scripts-info.bench: Measure the performance budgets on a generated fixture
scripts-info.test:real-world: Run x18n on real projects cloned from GitHub at pinned commits
